```ts
const monotonicznoscCiagu: FormulaDef = {
  id: "monotonicznosc-ciagu",
  topic: "Ciągi",
  name: "Monotoniczność ciągu",
  latex: "a_{n+1} - a_n",
  vars: [
    { id: "typ", label: "rodzaj", kind: "select", options: ["arytmetyczny", "geometryczny"] },
    { id: "a1", label: "a₁" },
    { id: "q", label: "q" },
    { id: "r", label: "r" },
  ],
  mode: "fixed",
  solve(_unknown, known, places, selects) {
    const typ = selects?.["typ"] ?? "arytmetyczny";
    const a1 = asRational(known["a1"], "a₁");
    const q = asRational(known["q"], "q");
    const r = asRational(known["r"], "r");
    let body: string; let note: string | undefined;
    if (typ === "arytmetyczny") {
      const c = cmp(r, ZERO);
      if (c > 0) { body = "r > 0"; note = "ciąg rosnący"; }
      else if (c < 0) { body = "r < 0"; note = "ciąg malejący"; }
      else { body = "r = 0"; note = "ciąg stały"; }
    } else {
      // geometryczny
      const cq = cmp(q, ZERO);
      if (cq === 0) { body = "q = 0"; note = "od drugiego wyrazu same zera"; }
      else if (cq < 0) { body = "q < 0"; note = "wyrazy naprzemienne (niemonotoniczny)"; }
      else {
        const c1 = cmp(sub(q, ONE), ZERO);
        if (c1 === 0) { body = "q = 1"; note = "ciąg stały"; }
        else if (c1 > 0) { // q > 1
          note = cmp(a1, ZERO) > 0 ? "ciąg rosnący" : "ciąg malejący";
          body = `q > 1, a_1 ${cmp(a1, ZERO) > 0 ? "> 0" : "< 0"}`;
        } else { // 0 < q < 1
          note = cmp(a1, ZERO) > 0 ? "ciąg malejący" : "ciąg rosnący";
          body = `0 < q < 1, a_1 ${cmp(a1, ZERO) > 0 ? "> 0" : "< 0"}`;
        }
      }
    }
    return { values: [], steps: [{ title: "1. Warunek", body, note }] };
  }
}
```

```ts
const rownanieTryg: FormulaDef = {
  id: "rownanie-trygonometryczne",
  topic: "Trygonometria",
  name: "Równanie trygonometryczne",
  latex: "\\sin x = a, \\; \\cos x = a, \\; \\operatorname{tg} x = a",
  vars: [
    { id: "fn", label: "funkcja", kind: "select", options: ["sin", "cos", "tg"] },
    { id: "a", label: "a" },
  ],
  mode: "fixed",
  solve(_unknown, known, places, selects) {
    const fn = selects?.["fn"] ?? "sin";
    const a = known["a"]; // Exact
    const av = approx(a);
    let deg: number;
    if (fn === "sin") {
      if (Math.abs(av) > 1) throw "|a| ≤ 1 dla sinusa";
      deg = (Math.asin(av) * 180) / Math.PI;
    } else if (fn === "cos") {
      if (Math.abs(av) > 1) throw "|a| ≤ 1 dla cosinusa";
      deg = (Math.acos(av) * 180) / Math.PI;
    } else {
      deg = (Math.atan(av) * 180) / Math.PI;
    }
    // Build solutions in degrees
    let sol: string;
    if (fn === "sin") sol = `x = ${trimNum(deg)}^\\circ + 360^\\circ k \\;\\lor\\; x = ${trimNum(180 - deg)}^\\circ + 360^\\circ k`;
    else if (fn === "cos") sol = `x = \\pm ${trimNum(deg)}^\\circ + 360^\\circ k`;
    else sol = `x = ${trimNum(deg)}^\\circ + 180^\\circ k`;
    ...
  }
}
```

### trygonometria-trojkat-punkt
```ts
const trygPunkt: FormulaDef = {
  id: "trygonometria-trojkat-punkt",
  subject: "matematyka",
  topic: "Trygonometria",
  name: "Funkcje trygonometryczne punktu M(x, y)",
  latex: "r = \\sqrt{x^2+y^2}, \\; \\sin\\alpha = \\frac{y}{r}, \\; \\cos\\alpha = \\frac{x}{r}, \\; \\operatorname{tg}\\alpha = \\frac{y}{x}",
  vars: [
    { id: "x", label: "x" },
    { id: "y", label: "y" },
  ],
  mode: "fixed",
  outputId: "w",
  outputLabel: "sin, cos, tg",
  solve(_unknown, known, places): FormulaSolution {
    const x = asRational(known["x"], "x");
    const y = asRational(known["y"], "y");
    if (isZero(x) && isZero(y)) throw new Error("punkt (0, 0) nie definiuje kąta");
    const r = sqrtRational(add(mul(x, x), mul(y, y)));
    const sin = divExact(exactOf(y), r);
    const cos = divExact(exactOf(x), r);
    const show = (e: Exact): string => {
      const lx = formatLatex(e);
      const dc = formatDecimal(e, places);
      return lx === dc ? lx : `${lx} \\approx ${dc}`;
    };
    const values: Exact[] = [r, sin, cos];
    const labels: string[] = ["r", "sin α", "cos α"];
    const results: string[] = [`r = ${show(r)}`, `\\sin\\alpha = ${show(sin)}`, `\\cos\\alpha = ${show(cos)}`];
    let note: string | undefined;
    if (isZero(x)) {
      note = "tg α nie istnieje (x = 0)";
    } else {
      const tg = exactOf(div(y, x));
      values.push(tg);
      labels.push("tg α");
      results.push(`\\operatorname{tg}\\alpha = ${show(tg)}`);
    }
    return {
      values, labels,
      steps: [
        { title: "1. Promień wodzący", body: `r = \\sqrt{${L(x)}^2 + ${L(y)}^2} = ${show(r)}` },
        { title: "2. Wynik", body: results.join(", \\; "), note },
      ],
    };
  },
};
```

lx : `${lx} \\\\approx ${dc}`;\n};\n\nconst checkPositive = (r: Rational, label: string): void => {\n  if (cmp(r, ZERO) <= 0) throw new Error(`${label} musi być dodatnia`);\n};\n\nconst prostopadloscian: FormulaDef = {\n  id: \"pole-przekatna-prostopadloscianu\",\n  subject: \"matematyka\",\n  topic: \"Stereometria\",\n  name: \"Prostopadłościan i sześcian: pole, przekątna, objętość\",\n  latex: \"P_c = 2(ab+bc+ac), \\\\\\\\; d = \\\\\\\\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}, \\\\\\\\; V = abc\",\n  vars: [\n    { id: \"a\", label: \"a\" },\n    { id: \"b\", label: \"b\" },\n    { id: \"c\", label: \"c\" },\n  ],\n  mode: \"fixed\",\n  outputId: \"w\",\n  outputLabel: \"P_c, d, V\",\n  solve(_unknown, known, places): FormulaSolution {\n    const a = asRational(known[\"a\"], \"a\");\n    const b = asRational(known[\"b\"], \"b\");\n    const c = asRational(known[\"c\"], \"c\");\n    checkPositive(a, \"a\");\n    checkPositive(b, \"b\");\n    checkPositive(c, \"c\");\n    const ab = mul(a, b);\n    const bc = mul(b, c);\n    const ac = mul(a, c);\n    const Pc = mul(of(2), add(add(ab, bc), ac));\n    const d2 = add(add(mul(a, a), mul(b, b)), mul(c, c));\n    const d = sqrtRational(d2);\n    const V = mul(mul(a, b), c);\n    const cube = cmp(a, b) === 0 && cmp(b, c) === 0;\n    return {\n      values: [exactOf(Pc), d, exactOf(V)],\n      labels: [\"P_c\", \"d\", \"V\"],\n      steps: [\n        { title: \"1. Pole całkowite\", body: `P_c = 2(ab+bc+ac) = 2(${L(ab)}+${L(bc)}+${L(ac)}) = ${show(exactOf(Pc), places)}` },\n        { title: \"2. Przekątna\", body: `d = \\\\\\\\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2} = \\\\\\\\sqrt{${L(d2)}} = ${show(d, places)}` },\n        { title: \"3. Objętość\", body: `V = abc = ${show(exactOf(V), places)}` },\n        {\n          title: \"4. Przypadek sześcianu\",\n          body: cube ? `a = b = c \\\\\\\\Rightarrow P_c = 6a^2 = ${show(exactOf(Pc), places)}, \\\\\\\\; d = a\\\\\\\\sqrt{3}, \\\\\\\\; V = a^3 = ${show(exactOf(V), places)}` : \"a ≠ b ≠ c — bryła nie jest sześcianem\",\n        },\n      ],\n    };\n  },\n};\n\nconst graniastoslupOstrolup: FormulaDef = {\n  id: \"pole-graniastoslupa-ostroslupa\",\n  subject: \"matematyka\",\n  topic: \"Stereometria\",\n  name: \"Graniastosłup prosty i ostrosłup prawidłowy\",\n  latex: \"P_c = 2P_b + P_{bocz}, \\\\\\\\; P_c = P_b + P_{bocz}\",\n  vars: [\n    { id: \"typ\", label: \"bryła\", kind: \"select\", options: [\"graniastoslup trojkatny\", \"ostrolup czworokatny\"] },\n    { id: \"a\", label: \"a (bok)\" },\n    { id: \"b\", label: \"b (bok)\" },\n    { id: \"c\", label: \"c (bok)\" },\n    { id: \"h\", label: \"h (wysokość)\" },\n  ],\n  mode: \"fixed\",\n  outputId: \"w\",\n  outputLabel: \"P_b, P_c, V\",\n  solve(_unknown, known, places, selects): FormulaSolution {\n    const typ = selects?.[\"typ\"] ?? \"graniastoslup trojkatny\";\n    if (typ === \"graniastoslup trojkatny\") {\n      const a = asRational(known[\"a\"], \"a\");\n      const b = asRational(known[\"b\"], \"b\");\n      const c = asRational(known[\"c\"], \"c\");\n      const h = asRational(known[\"h\"], \"h\");\n      checkPositive(a, \"a\");\n      checkPositive(b, \"b\");\n      checkPositive(c, \"c\");\n      checkPositive(h, \"h\");\n      const p = div(add(add(a, b), c), of(2));\n      if (cmp(sub(p, a), ZERO) <= 0 || cmp(sub(p, b), ZERO) <= 0 || cmp(sub(p, c), ZERO) <= 0)\n        throw new Error(\"boki podstawy nie spełniają nierówności trójkąta\");\n      const prod = mul(mul(mul(p, sub(p, a)), sub(p, b)), sub(p, c));\n      const Pb = sqrtRational(prod);\n      const obwod = add(add(a, b), c);\n      const Pbocz = mul(obwod, h);\n      const Pc = add(mul(of(2), Pb), Pbocz);\n      const V = mul(Pb, h);\n      return {\n        values: [Pb, exactOf(Pc), exactOf(V)],\n        labels: [\"P_b\", \"P_c\", \"V\"],\n        steps: [\n          { title: \"1. Pole podstawy (Heron)\", body: `P_b = \\\\\\\\sqrt{p(p-a)(p-b)(p-c)} = \\\\\\\\sqrt{${L(prod)}} = ${show(Pb, places)}` },\n          { title: \"2. Pole boczne\", body: `P_{bocz} = (a+b+c)\\\\\\\\cdot h = ${L(obwod)} \\\\\\\\cdot ${L(h)} = ${show(exactOf(Pbocz), places)}` },\n          { title: \"3. Pole całkowite\", body: `P_c = 2P_b + P_{bocz} = ${show(exactOf(Pc), places)}` },\n          { title: \"4. Objętość\", body: `V = P_b \\\\\\\\cdot h = ${show(exactOf(V), places)}` },\n        ],\n      };\n    }\n    const a = asRational(known[\"a\"], \"a\");\n    const h = asRational(known[\"h\"], \"h\");\n    checkPositive(a, \"a\");\n    checkPositive(h, \"h\");\n    const Pb = mul(a, a);\n    const trawers = sqrtRational(add(mul(h, h), mul(mul(a, a), { p: 1n, q: 4n })));\n    const Pbocz = mul(mul(of(2), a), trawers);\n    const Pc = add(Pb, Pbocz);\n    const V = div(mul(mul(a, a), h), of(3));\n    return {\n      values: [exactOf(Pb), exactOf(Pc), exactOf(V)],\n      labels: [\"P_b\", \"P_c\", \"V\"],\n      steps: [\n        { title: \"1. Pole podstawy\", body: `P_b = a^2 = ${show(exactOf(Pb), places)}` },\n        { title: \"2. Wysokość ściany bocznej\", body: `h_s = \\\\\\\\sqrt{h^2 + \\\\\\\\frac{a^2}{4}} = ${show(trawers, places)}` },\n        { title: \"3. Pole boczne i całkowite\", body: `P_{bocz} = 4\\\\\\\\cdot\\\\\\\\frac{1}{2}a\\\\\\\\cdot h_s = 2a\\\\\\\\cdot h_s = ${show(exactOf(Pbocz), places)}, \\\\\\\\; P_c = P_b + P_{bocz} = ${show(exactOf(Pc), places)}` },\n        { title: \"4. Objętość\", body: `V = \\\\\\\\frac{1}{3}a^2 h = ${show(exactOf(V), places)}` },\n      ],\n    };\n  },\n};\n\nconst walec: FormulaDef = {\n  id: \"pole-walca\",\n  subject: \"matematyka\",\n  topic: \"Stereometria\",\n  name: \"Walec: pola i objętość\",\n  latex: \"P_{bocz} = 2\\\\\\\\pi r h, \\\\\\\\; P_c = 2\\\\\\\\pi r(r+h), \\\\\\\\; V = \\\\\\\\pi r^2 h\",\n  vars: [\n    { id: \"r\", label: \"r\" },\n    { id: \"h\", label: \"h\" },\n  ],\n  mode: \"fixed\",\n  outputId: \"w\",\n  outputLabel: \"P_bocz, P_c, V\",\n  solve(_unknown, known, places): FormulaSolution {\n    const r = asRational(known[\"r\"], \"r\");\n    const h = asRational(known[\"h\"], \"h\");\n    checkPositive(r, \"r\");\n    checkPositive(h, \"h\");\n    const Pbocz = mulRat(PI, mul(mul(of(2), r), h));\n    const Pc = mulRat(PI, mul(mul(of(2), r), add(r, h)));\n    const V = mulRat(PI, mul(mul(r, r), h));\n    return {\n      values: [Pbocz, Pc, V],\n      labels: [\"P_bocz\", \"P_c\", \"V\"],\n      steps: [\n        { title: \"1. Pole boczne\", body: `P_{bocz} = 2\\\\\\\\pi r h = 2\\\\\\\\pi \\\\\\\\cdot ${L(r)} \\\\\\\\cdot ${L(h)} = ${show(Pbocz, places)}` },\n        { title: \"2. Pole całkowite\", body: `P_c = 2\\\\\\\\pi r(r+h) = ${show(Pc, places)}` },\n        { title: \"3. Objętość\", body: `V = \\\\\\\\pi r^2 h = ${show(V, places)}` },\n      ],\n    };\n  },\n};\n\nconst stozek: FormulaDef = {\n  id: \"pole-tworzaca-stozka\",\n  subject: \"matematyka\",\n  topic: \"Stereometria\",\n  name: \"Stożek: tworząca, pola i objętość\",\n  latex: \"l = \\\\\\\\sqrt{r^2+h^2}, \\\\\\\\; P_{bocz} = \\\\\\\\pi r l, \\\\\\\\; P_c = \\\\\\\\pi r(l+r), \\\\\\\\; V = \\\\\\\\frac{1}{3}\\\\\\\\pi r^2 h\",\n  vars: [\n    { id: \"r\", label: \"r\" },\n    { id: \"h\", label: \"h\" },\n  ],\n  mode: \"fixed\",\n  outputId: \"w\",\n  outputLabel: \"l, P_bocz, P_c, V\",\n  solve(_unknown, known, places): FormulaSolution {\n    const r = asRational(known[\"r\"], \"r\");\n    const h = asRational(known[\"h\"], \"h\");\n    checkPositive(r, \"r\");\n    checkPositive(h, \"h\");\n    const l = sqrtRational(add(mul(r, r), mul(h, h)));\n    const Pbocz = mulRat(PI, mul(r, l));\n    const Pc = mulRat(PI, mul(r, { p: 1n, q: 1n }));\n    const PcFull = addExactRat(Pbocz, mulRat(PI, mul(r, r)));\n    const V = mulRat(PI, div(mul(mul(r, r), h), of(3)));\n    return {\n      values: [l, Pbocz, PcFull, V],\n      labels: [\"l\", \"P_bocz\", \"P_c\", \"V\"],\n      steps: [\n        { title: \"1. Tworząca\", body: `l = \\\\\\\\sqrt{r^2+h^2} = \\\\\\\\sqrt{${L(mul(r, r))}+${L(mul(h, h))}} = ${show(l, places)}` },\n        { title: \"2. Pole boczne\", body: `P_{bocz} = \\\\\\\\pi r l = \\\\\\\\pi \\\\\\\\cdot ${L(r)} \\\\\\\\cdot ${show(l, places)} = ${show(Pbocz, places)}` },\n        { title: \"3. Pole całkowite\", body: `P_c = \\\\\\\\pi r(l+r) = ${show(PcFull, places)}` },\n        { title: \"4. Objętość\", body: `V = \\\\\\\\frac{1}{3}\\\\\\\\pi r^2 h = ${show(V, places)}` },\n      ],\n    };\n  },\n};\n\nconst addExactRat = (a: Exact, b: Exact): Exact => {\n  if (a.irr?.type === \"pi\" && b.irr?.type === \"pi\") {\n    const coef = {\n      p: a.irr.coef.p + b.irr.coef.p,\n      q: a.irr.coef.q * b.irr.coef.q,\n    };\n    if (coef.p === 0n) return { rat: ZERO, irr: null };\n    return { rat: ZERO, irr: { type: \"pi\", coef } };\n  }\n  throw new Error(\"dokładne: mieszanie typów w addExactRat\");\n};\n\nconst brylySciete: FormulaDef = {\n  id: \"bryly-sciete\",\n  subject: \"matematyka\",\n  topic: \"Stereometria\",\n  name: \"Bryły ścięte: stożek i ostrosłup\",\n  latex: \"V = \\\\\\\\frac{\\\\\\\\pi h}{3}(R^2+Rr+r^2), \\\\\\\\; V = \\\\\\\\frac{h}{3}(P_1+\\\\\\\\sqrt{P_1P_2}+P_2)\",\n  vars: [\n    { id: \"typ\", label: \"bryła\", kind: \"select\", options: [\"stozek sciaty\", \"ostroslup sciaty\"] },\n    { id: \"R\", label: \"R (większy promień / pole)\" },\n    { id: \"r\", label: \"r (mniejszy promień / pole)\" },\n    { id: \"h\", label: \"h\" },\n  ],\n  mode: \"fixed\",\n  outputId: \"w\",\n  outputLabel: \"l, P_bocz, V\",\n  solve(_unknown, known, places, selects): FormulaSolution {\n    const typ = selects?.[\"typ\"] ?? \"stozek sciaty\";\n    const R = asRational(known[\"R\"], \"R\");\n    const r = asRational(known[\"r\"], \"r\");\n    const h = asRational(known[\"h\"], \"h\");\n    checkPositive(R, \"R\");\n    checkPositive(r, \"r\");\n    checkPositive(h, \"h\");\n    if (typ === \"stozek sciaty\") {\n      if (cmp(R, r) < 0) throw new Error(\"R ≥ r\");\n      const dRr = sub(R, r);\n      const l = sqrtRational(add(mul(h, h), mul(dRr, dRr)));\n      const Pbocz = mulRat(PI, mul(add(R, r), l));\n      const inner = add(mul(R, R), add(mul(R, r), mul(r, r)));\n      const V = mulRat(PI, div(mul(h, inner), of(3)));\n      return {\n        values: [l, Pbocz, V],\n        labels: [\"l\", \"P_bocz\", \"V\"],\n        steps: [\n          { title: \"1. Tworząca\", body: `l = \\\\\\\\sqrt{h^2+(R-r)^2} = \\\\\\\\sqrt{${L(mul(h, h))}+${L(mul(dRr, dRr))}} = ${show(l, places)}` },\n          { title: \"2. Pole boczne\", body: `P_{bocz} = \\\\\\\\pi(R+r)l = ${show(Pbocz, places)}` },\n          { title: \"3. Objętość\", body: `V = \\\\\\\\frac{\\\\\\\\pi h}{3}(R^2+Rr+r^2) = ${show(V, places)}` },\n        ],\n      };\n    }\n    const Rr = mul(R, r);\n    const s = sqrtRational(Rr);\n    const V = div(mul(h, add(add(R, s), r)), of(3));\n    return {\n      values: [V],\n      labels: [\"V\"],\n      steps: [\n        { title: \"1. Średnia proporcjonalna\", body: `\\\\\\\\sqrt{P_1 P_2} = \\\\\\\\sqrt{${L(Rr)}} = ${show(s, places)}` },\n        { title: \"2. Objętość\", body: `V = \\\\\\\\frac{h}{3}(P_1+\\\\\\\\sqrt{P_1P_2}+P_2) = ${show(V, places)}` },\n      ],\n    };\n  },\n};\n\nvoid approx;\nvoid neg;\nvoid formatLatex;\n\nexport const MATH_STEREOMETRIA: FormulaDef[] = [\n  prostopadloscian,\n  graniastoslupOstrolup,\n  walec,\n  stozek,\n  brylySciete,\n];\n",
